entities.summary: Lynn Fitch is an American lawyer and politician serving as the 40th Mississippi Attorney General since 2020. She is the first woman to serve in the role and the first Republican since 1878. Previously, she was the 54th State Treasurer of Mississippi from 2012 to 2020.
